title: Iga Świątek defeats Marta Kostiuk and advances to quarterfinals in Toronto
seoTitle: Iga Świątek beats Marta Kostiuk, reaches Toronto quarters
subtitle: The Pole turned the score against the Ukrainian and stays strong in the tournament
excerpt: After overturning an early loss, Iga Świątek beat Marta Kostiuk in Toronto, advancing to the quarterfinals and preparing to face Diana Sznajder.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Iga Świątek turned the score around against Ukrainian Marta Kostiuk in the latest Toronto round, securing a spot in the quarterfinals. The match, played amid high expectations, ended with the Pole winning 3-6, 6-1, 6-2.

Iga Świątek's Victory over Marta Kostiuk

The Ukrainian started the encounter with an advantage, taking the first set 6-3. However, Świątek responded consistently, overturning the score and closing the match in three sets. Commentator Dawid Olejniczak noted that the win made a good impression, especially due to the ability to overcome the early deficit.

Commentators' Reaction to Świątek's Performance

Olejniczak highlighted Świątek's mental strength in turning the match around, pointing out that the Pole displayed the necessary aggression in decisive moments. The specialist likened the player's performance to a counter‑attack that surprised the audience, reinforcing confidence in the continuation of her campaign.

Świątek's Next Match in Toronto

With all other Polish representatives eliminated, Świątek will be the sole player from the nation on the Canadian courts. On Monday night into Tuesday, she will face Diana Sznajder in the quarterfinals, a match highly anticipated by fans.

Analysis of Marta Kostiuk's Career

Kostiuk, who had already collected titles in Rouen and Madrid and had reached semifinals at Roland Garros and Wimbledon, rose to prominent positions in the WTA rankings. Despite her successes, analysts note that the player is still looking to turn emotional control into competitive aggression.

Mental Challenges in High‑Level Tennis

In an interview on the program "Śniadanie z 1+1", Kostiuk admitted that the mental side has been her biggest obstacle, acknowledging the importance of psychology as the level of play rises. Commentators suggest that, although she has learned to manage her emotions, she still needs to demonstrate that calmness as decisive strength in critical moments.
